_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: REQ-VBTW-009/013/014 — additive extension of the already-landed VatCorrection register with the fields VatSuppletieDetectionService needs to persist a filed/current rubriek snapshot, per-rubriek deltas, the suppletie-threshold decision, the 8-week filing deadline, and a link to the compiled GL correction posting. REQ-VBTW-012 audit coverage is already satisfied for VatCorrection/VatReturn by add-shillinq-audit-trail.json's x-openregister-audit-trail.enabled flag — not touched here. Merged additively onto the monolith per ADR-037 — no existing field, state, or transition is touched.

filedSnapshot.description: As-filed per-rubriek totals (audit trail of the original filed figures), captured from the VATDeclaration rows persisted at filing time. Populated by VatSuppletieDetectionService::detect() (REQ-VBTW-013).
filedSnapshot.title: Filed Snapshot

currentSnapshot.description: Per-rubriek totals recomputed live from GL at detection time, in the same shape as filedSnapshot. Populated by VatSuppletieDetectionService::detect() (REQ-VBTW-013).
currentSnapshot.title: Current Snapshot

rubriekDeltas.description: Per-rubriek delta (currentSnapshot minus filedSnapshot) for every bucket with a non-zero difference. Populated by VatSuppletieDetectionService::prepare() (REQ-VBTW-014).

glAccountNumber.description: Account the original rubriek posted to; reused for the GL correction line.

rubriekDeltas.title: Rubriek Deltas

detectedAt.description: Timestamp VatSuppletieDetectionService::detect() created this record (the 'detected' sub-state — REQ-VBTW-014).
detectedAt.title: Detected At

preparedAt.description: Timestamp VatSuppletieDetectionService::prepare() finished compiling deltas + the GL posting (the 'prepared' sub-state — record is draft but operator-reviewable and ready to file, REQ-VBTW-014).
preparedAt.title: Prepared At

thresholdExceeded.description: True when abs(correctionAmount) >= the statutory €1.000 suppletie grens (verified against belastingdienst.nl, REQ-VBTW-014); operator still decides whether to file.
thresholdExceeded.title: Threshold Exceeded

filingDeadline.description: preparedAt + 8 weeks — the statutory suppletie filing deadline once a threshold-exceeding correction is discovered (REQ-VBTW-014).
filingDeadline.title: Filing Deadline

glCorrectionTransactionId.description: FK to the draft GLTransaction booking this correction's delta, compiled by VatSuppletieDetectionService::prepare() (REQ-VBTW-014). Never auto-posted.
glCorrectionTransactionId.title: GL Correction Transaction ID

objects.reason: Voorbelasting Q1 2026 onderrapporteerd door invoerfout — na afsluiting alsnog geboekte inkoopfactuur van €500 excl. BTW hoog tarief.
objects.notes: Above de €1.000-grens — suppletie verplicht binnen 8 weken na ontdekking.

objects.reason: Dubbel geboekte creditnota gecorrigeerd na afsluiting.
objects.notes: Onder de €1.000-grens — mag worden verwerkt in de eerstvolgende aangifte; nog niet beoordeeld door operator (detected, niet prepared).
